title: Titre de séjour saisonnier: documents and steps (with checklist)
shortAnswer: Short answer: the visa saisonnier lasts 3 months. To keep working you have to apply for the carte de séjour pluriannuelle “travailleur saisonnier”, valid for up to 3 years. It lets you take seasonal jobs for up to 6 months a year, as long as you keep your main home outside France.

blocks.text: How does the carte travailleur saisonnier work?

items: Duration: up to 3 years, renewable.
Limit: a maximum of 6 months in France per year, stay and work combined.
Residence: you commit to keeping your main home in your own country.
Seasonal work only: if you take another kind of job or stay longer than 6 months, the card can be withdrawn.
No change of status: to move to salarié or travailleur temporaire you need a new visa from the consulate.
No family reunification with this card.
Before you travel: your employer applies for the autorisation de travail and you get the 3-month visa saisonnier at the consulate.
On arrival: you gather the documents from the checklist.
Application: you file it with the préfecture where you live, following its own procedure. Every préfecture has its own rules: check yours.
Collection: you pay the timbre fiscal and pick up your card.
Visa saisonnier (scan or photo)
Passport: data page and every page with a stamp
Birth certificate, apostilled and translated into French
Contrat de travail
Attestation d'hébergement + pièce d'identité of the person hosting you
Extrait Kbis of the company (ask your employer for it)
Autorisation de travail (the same one used for the visa)
Plane, train or bus tickets showing your entry into France
Photo in French format (choose the “Titre de séjour” option in the photo booths)
An active French phone number
Attestation du maintien de la résidence hors de France
Contrat d'engagement à respecter les principes de la République
Waiting until the visa is about to expire to start the process.
A birth certificate with no apostille, or with a translation that is not sworn.
Not keeping your entry tickets: they are what prove the 6-month limit.
Spending more than 6 months in France in the year: it puts your renewal at risk.

items.question: Can I work for another employer?
items.answer: Yes, in another seasonal job, but the new employer has to apply for a new autorisation de travail.

items.question: How do I renew the card at the end of the 3 years?
items.answer: Between 4 and 2 months before it expires, with a new seasonal contract and proof that you respected the 6 months per year.

items.question: Can Algerians apply for it?
items.answer: No, they are covered by the French-Algerian agreement.
